h/acc (hacking accelerationism): using accelerationism, technology, speed for open source and hacking.proprietary is now open source. a frontier model with ghidra turns any binary back into readable source. compiling was never encryption, just a delay.reverse engineering is the new pretraining. decompile, refactor, verify it rebuilds, train on it, repeat. the data wall only exists for people who can't read machine code.tech should belong to everyone, not just three cloud providers. when weights get locked, steal the keys, or distill the weights and release them.disruption is the core tenet of healthy capitalism. the question isn't whether corporations profit, but when their tech gets breached and open sourced.closed source is unstable. defenders must secure every surface, attackers only need a few vulnerabilities, and the barrier to hacking drops faster than anyone can patch.the bottleneck was never generation, it's error correction. code checks itself: it compiles, or it doesn't. the exploit crashes, or it doesn't. whoever owns the cheapest falsifier owns the fastest feedback loop, and that's always been the hacker.open source is a competitive strategy. more eyes, more forks, more experiments. it out-evolves closed source because it keeps the diversity that rent extraction suppresses.hacking is just more equitable innovation with a shorter feedback loop. every jailbreak and model extraction proves the moat was never technical, just legal and social.every sandbox will be tested by something that never sleeps. a falsifier only counts if the optimizer can't touch it, and safety that can't survive an adversary is just marketing.something bad will save us. any world with doom is first a world with other really bad things. don't safety-wash them small enough to shrug off. hackers break things early and loudly, so the warning shot lands while it's still survivable.the future belongs to people who can read the machine. when agents write all the code, the scarce skill is breaking, verifying, and knowing when there's nothing there.the singularity will not require a subscription. gatekeeping intelligence is the real alignment failure. compute, infrastructure, and models should be free for anyone.you can't patch out curiosity. accelerate for the love of the game. h/acc will make sure the door stays open to everyone.
